recognize_zh: 視野中最醒目的是大量有核紅血球（圓形深染小核、灰藍到粉紅色細胞質），合併偏大的多染性紅血球、深染無中央淡染的小球形紅血球，以及數個紅血球黏成小團；有核紅血球大量出現加上球形細胞與紅血球凝集，符合自體免疫溶血性貧血的骨髓強力代償。
features: Numerous nucleated red cells (polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts) with round, dense nuclei, some in small groups
Large polychromatophilic red cells (macrocytic, bluish-grey) indicating reticulocytosis
Scattered dense spherocytes/microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Small irregular clusters of adherent red cells, suggestive of agglutination, though only focal in this field
Two neutrophils and scattered platelets; occasional poikilocytes including a teardrop-shaped cell
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly increased nucleated red cells, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts, together with prominent polychromasia, macrocytic reticulocytes and scattered spherocytes. Several small irregular clumps of red cells are present, suggestive of autoagglutination, although agglutination is focal rather than marked in this particular field. Neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable and platelets are present. In the setting of a strongly positive direct antiglobulin test and reticulocytosis, findings are consistent with autoimmune hemolytic anemia with brisk erythroid regeneration; red cell agglutination with spuriously high MCV and MCHC should prompt evaluation for a cold-reactive autoantibody.

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinin disease shows large irregular red cell agglutinates that disperse on warming to 37 °C, with a DAT positive for C3d only and a high-titer cold agglutinin, whereas warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG positivity.
Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells resembling coins in the thin area of a smear, associated with paraproteins or high fibrinogen, not irregular grape-like clumps.
HS shows spherocytes and polychromasia but a negative DAT, no agglutination, and a family history or abnormal EMA binding.
Leukoerythroblastosis pairs nucleated red cells with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells without spherocytes, agglutination or a positive DAT.
